description: Search Denpex's bundled 721-class failure encyclopedia by error code, keyword, or symptom (e.g. 'Xid 79', 'NCCL timeout', 'loss is NaN', 'CUDA out of memory'). Returns the most relevant known failures with their fixes. Works fully offline and costs no quota. Use `diagnose_crash` instead when you have a full crash log.

query.description: Error code, message, or symptom to look up.

name: lookup_failure
title: Look up a known GPU/ML failure
